11:     logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
12:     tau_filter: float,

action.old_text: raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate each input matrix
    for name, mat in [('logp_with_result', logp_with_result),
                      ('logp_call_only', logp_call_only),
                      ('logp_no_call', logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if not np.issubdtype(mat.dtype, np.floating) and not np.issubdtype(mat.dtype, np.integer):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must have numeric dtype")
        if mat.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    # Check shapes match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_no_call.shape
    # Compute weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    if raw_weights.sum() == 0:
        raise ValueError("All weights are zero (horizon too large or negative)")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    # Baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    # Margins
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    # Decision
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    return keep, margins
